run_zimage_inpaint_pipeline: run the ZImageInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image given a prompt, source image, and binary mask
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into embeddings using the ZImage tokenizer and text encoder with chat template formatting
prepare_inpaint_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents for inpainting by encoding and resizing to latent dimensions
blend_denoised_latents: blend denoised latents with original image latents using the inpainting mask during the denoising loop
calculate_scheduler_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
